title: Developer for Downtown North Mixed Use Development
short_description: Mixed-use redevelopment in Bridgeport including historic building rehabilitation and affordable housing.
project_scope: Redevelopment of the Downtown North area through a mixed-use, mixed-income development covering the full redevelopment area. Scope includes preservation and rehabilitation of the historic Davidson Building, development of at least three identified sites (Site 1 Davidson Building, Site 2 Davidson Block, Site 3 Main and Middle), provision of at least 20% deed-restricted affordable housing units, activation of street frontage and commercial uses, and incorporation of strong architectural, urban design, green infrastructure, and environmental sustainability measures.
services: Developer/design-build services for mixed-use redevelopment, including rehabilitation and refurbishment of a historic building.
relevance_explanation:
- Mixed-use building redevelopment may involve substantial structural work, especially historic rehabilitation.
- However, the notice is primarily for a developer/design-build team rather than explicit structural or specialist engineering services.
- No clear information on structural complexity, spans, long-span roofs, or special structures.
- Sustainability and architectural quality are mentioned, which slightly increases strategic interest.
- Building type is general mixed-use urban development, not a priority sbp typology such as bridges, stadiums, or special long-span structures.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Useful cost drivers mentioned: full redevelopment of the area, rehabilitation of the historic Davidson Building, mixed-use and mixed-income development across three sites, affordable housing component, commercial frontage, and sustainability requirements. A realistic USD estimate is not possible from the available information alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. The notice is only an advance notice for a future developer/design-build procurement, so no realistic sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines: Design Build/Developer and Rehabilitation & Refurbishment. The source does not specify detailed reference counts or qualification thresholds.
contracting_authority: City of Bridgeport, Bridgeport, Connecticut, USA. Contact: Laura Demoura. Email: laura.demoura@bridgeportct.gov. Phone: 203-576-3960. Fax: 203-576-3959.
notes: Advance notice only. The original RFQ/RFP was canceled and is expected to be re-advertised prior to June 2026. IMS notes that the package is expected to be available prior to 06/01/2026 and requests no phone calls, faxes, or contact with the agency at this time. Stage: Advance Notice. Project #: 813210-1. ProjectID: 1004892.
